description: This file defines the class ModifyAclEntryResponse, which is a response object for the ModifyAclEntry command related to Access Control List (ACL) entries on a 'Thing'. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, representing the ACL entry, and handling response metadata such as HTTP status codes.

classes.name: ModifyAclEntryResponse
classes.description: A response class for the ModifyAclEntry command, representing the outcome of modifying an ACL entry. It includes static factory methods for creating responses with specific status codes, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the modified ACL entry and related identifiers.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method for a response indicating a new ACL entry has been created, with HTTP 201 status.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method for a response indicating an ACL entry has been modified, with HTTP 204 status.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAclEntryResponse instance from a JSON string or object, deserializing the response details.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getAclEntry
methods.description: Returns the ACL entry associated with this response.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with the provided DittoHeaders.
